'''Samantha Moon''' is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Little is known about Moon's life, other than she became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, where she voiced several minor characters. She gained her most notable role during {{aniseries|SM}} where she voiced [[Officer Jenny]]. Moon eventually left the series with her role of Officer Jenny going to [[Martha Harms]].
